title: Wonderful Everyday — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Nobody designed the part of Wonderful Everyday you experience — it was inherited. Wonderful Everyday: Diskontinuierliches Dasein (Japanese: 素晴らしき日々 ～不連続存在～, Hepburn: Subarashiki Hibi ~Furenzoku Sonzai~), often abbreviated as SubaHibi, is a Japanese denpa horror mystery visual novel developed by KeroQ. It was released for Windows in 2010 and was given an international release by Frontwing in 2017.

Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. It ranked second place overall as well as first place in the Scenario and Music categories, and 3rd in Graphics. Additionally, Yuki Minakami was voted the 4th best character from games of that year.
